modal.title: Primary / Secondary
modal.primary: A Primary account means you play your purchased games from your main profile — all progress and saves are tied to your main user, and you won't need to switch to another user to start a game.
modal.secondary: A Secondary account means you play your purchased games from the account I provide — so all saves and progress are tied to a specific user, and you'll need to switch to that user to play your purchased game.
